posts.headline: Put it in Ra just posted back-to-back editions of scrutiny and it's now a fifth straight day of silence from One Nut Barner while his league-best 20-8 pedigree sits at 0-1.
posts.detail: A 1.5 average finish team with two titles' worth of swagger can't stay silent forever — 123.66 points and an 0-1 start is a crisis for a résumé this decorated, and the receipts keep piling up.

posts.headline: Sasinci's title banner is now officially a museum piece — 0-1, 101.6 points, and a 13-15 career record that keeps getting worse by the week.
posts.detail: Six straight editions of Big Head getting cooked and still no signs of life; at this rate Megamind threatens to quit the league before he threatens to win a game.

posts.headline: talentedtenthh is still unbeaten and I still don't believe it — 120.4 points is bottom-three in the league for a 4-10, dead-last résumé.
posts.detail: The untalented tenth keeps cashing in on fumes, and a 1-0 record built on the third-worst scoring output in Busters Anonymous won't survive contact with a real week.

posts.headline: Thicks is 1-0 for a second straight week but 138.94 points remains the softest winning score by a title-pedigree team in the league.
posts.detail: A 14-14 career record and 5.5 average finish says this crown has been coasting, not commanding — the ring means nothing if the scoreboard keeps whispering.

posts.headline: BIBLE OR THE BELT is still buried at a league-worst 72.02 points and the Ultimate Light Skin's judgment day has become the longest-running plague in this column.
posts.detail: Four straight editions of fire and brimstone for a 13-14-1 career team that drafted a defensive player first overall — some sins you just can't outrun.
